cases.name: cuj1-checking-the-week
cases.note: CUJ 1: Sunday evening. Lower and Run intervals done, an unplanned Wednesday, nothing on Thursday, a saved workout instead of Long run on Saturday.

cases.name: cuj2-today-pending
cases.note: The Data shapes example: CUJ 2 reduced to the Thursday plan. An unplanned morning run leaves today Pending.

cases.name: cuj2-today-is-not-over
cases.note: CUJ 2 with the whole Hybrid block: Thursday morning, an unplanned run. Thursday is Pending, Saturday is Planned.

cases.name: cuj2-upper-done-in-the-evening
cases.note: CUJ 2, later: a Set completed in a Workout started from Upper makes Thursday Done, whatever else was logged that day.

cases.name: cuj3-rotating-routine-only
cases.note: CUJ 3: a rotating Cadence plans no date, so the loaders pass no plan. Days with a Logged Workout are Trained, every other day No plan, nothing Not done.

cases.name: cuj4-session-after-midnight
cases.note: CUJ 4: Lower started at 00:30 local on Tuesday (23:30 UTC on Monday). Its local date is Tuesday, so Monday is Not done and Tuesday Done differently.

cases.name: cuj5-abandoned-planned-workout
cases.note: CUJ 5: Run intervals started from Up next on Tuesday and left with no completed Set. It is not a Logged Workout, so Tuesday is Not done.

cases.name: past-day-partly-done
cases.note: D1: a past day with two planned entries and one matched is Partly done.

cases.name: two-routines-plan-the-same-template
cases.note: D1: a Workout Template planned by two Routines on one day is two planned entries, and a Workout matches at most one. comparedRoutineIds is ascending whatever the input order.

cases.name: one-routine-plans-a-template-twice
cases.note: D1: one Routine planning a template twice on one day needs two Workouts linked to it.

cases.name: unlinked-workout-on-a-planned-day
cases.note: D1: a Workout with no Template Link on a past planned day is Done differently.

cases.name: open-workout-matches-the-plan
cases.note: D1: an Open Workout with a Performed Set, linked to today's planned template, is Done.

cases.name: no-performed-set-is-not-done
cases.note: D0: a Workout linked to the planned template whose Sets are all incomplete is ignored, so the past planned day is Not done.

cases.name: today-one-of-two-matched
cases.note: D1: today with one of two planned entries matched stays Pending.

cases.name: today-every-entry-matched
cases.note: D1: today with every planned entry matched is Done.

cases.name: no-plans
cases.note: D1: with no plan at all, a day is Trained or No plan. A future date with a Workout is still Trained.

cases.name: plan-with-no-entries-is-ignored
cases.note: D1: a weekly Routine with no planning entries plans nothing: it is not compared, and the unplanned days are No plan rather than Rest.

cases.name: workouts-outside-the-week-are-ignored
cases.note: D1: Workouts dated the Sunday before and the Monday after the week, both linked to Monday's template, change nothing.

cases.name: sunday-week-start
cases.note: D1: a week starting Sunday. Weekday 7 plans the first day and weekday 6 the last, which is in the future.

cases.name: today-after-the-week-rejects
cases.note: D1: today must fall inside the week; the next Monday is rejected with an argument error.

cases.name: today-before-the-week-rejects
cases.note: D1: today must fall inside the week; the Sunday before is rejected with an argument error.

cases.name: cuj1-summary
cases.note: CUJ 1: "2 done · 1 done differently · 1 not done · 1 trained". Rest, Pending, Planned and No plan are not counted.

cases.name: workout-without-a-focus
cases.note: D3: a Workout with no Focus sums under the key "none".

cases.name: two-focuses-on-one-date
cases.note: D3: each Focus sums its own Workouts. Seconds are truncated per Workout (1 234.999 s is 1 234 s), and a Workout crossing midnight counts toward its local date.

cases.name: open-workout-counts-without-time
cases.note: D2 and D3: an Open Workout counts toward workoutCount but adds no time and no key.

cases.name: ended-before-it-started
cases.note: D3: a Workout that ended before it started adds 0 seconds, and its key is still present.

cases.name: no-performed-set-is-ignored
cases.note: D0: a Workout with no Performed Set is not a Logged Workout: no count, no time, no key.

cases.name: workouts-outside-the-range-are-ignored
cases.note: D2: Workouts dated before from or after to are ignored.

cases.name: a-366-date-range
cases.note: D2: the longest range, 366 dates, here across 29 February 2024. Every date has an entry, in order.

cases.name: a-367-date-range-rejects
cases.note: D2: one date more than 366 is rejected with an argument error.

cases.name: from-after-to-rejects
cases.note: D2: from after to is rejected with an argument error.
